[[Dayoesh]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Location==
*[[The Desolation]]
**{{NPC location|Crystal Overlook}}

==Dialogue==
:''"They killed my wife...my daughter...my, my.... They took my life. You! You like like...but no. Dead, they're all dead. The [[Graven Monolith|graven monolith]]s! They killed them all. Bring me their bones; the bones of those monsters. For 5 [[Inscribed Shard]]s, I will give you what's left of my family's belongings...what little they left behind:"''
